stages.title: Story Completion & Core Progression
stages.summary: Finish the main campaign and unlock all story-related trophies while naturally discovering the map and core mechanics.
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
stages.notes: Play on any difficulty; story trophies are unmissable and unlock sequentially.

stages.title: Open World Exploration & Side Content
stages.summary: Sweep the map for collectibles, complete all stranger missions, side activities, and discover every named location.
stages.notes: Use the in-game checklist and map filters; nothing is missable post-story.

stages.title: Combat Mastery & Challenge Cleanup
stages.summary: Max out weapon proficiency, survive escalating wanted levels, and knock out all combat, driving, and stunt challenges.
stages.notes: Grind in private sessions or low-pop lobbies to avoid interference; track progress via stats menu.

stages.title: Stage 4: Completionist & Mastery
stages.summary: Wrap up all remaining side content, achieve 100% completion, and master every gameplay system.
stages.notes: Requires 100% completion tracker fulfillment; purchase all safehouses, win all races, and complete every side activity.

stages.title: Stage 5: Platinum Cleanup
stages.summary: Mop up any missed miscellaneous trophies and claim the platinum.
stages.notes: Final sweep for any overlooked bronze trophies; 'Welcome to Vice City' unlocks on first launch if missed.
